scope: Additive passive-building baseline for the permanent Crafting Station only; phase-selected Crafted Defenses remain temporary and out of scope.
game_version: Official 2025/2026 phase notes and current public secondary evidence consulted on 2026-09-20.

sources.title: Welcome to Let’s Get Crafty Update!
sources.limitations: Establishes the Station as the TH17/maximum-TH interface for temporary Crafted Defenses and phase changes; it does not define its standalone attack targetability, destruction accounting, collision or weapon behavior.

sources.title: TOWN HALL 18 Crash Lands! - Update
sources.limitations: Confirms that snapshots after a phase reset show only the Crafting Station, demonstrating its permanent base presence; it does not publish standalone battle targetability or destruction rules.

sources.title: Crafted Defenses
sources.limitations: Confirms the Station’s active/inactive phase lifecycle and removal below the required TH, but supplies no attack, target, destruction, collision or replay contract.

sources.title: Crafting Station
sources.limitations: Reports a free 3x3 Station which, before a Crafted Defense is selected, is treated as a defensive building for defense-targeting units. It gives no immutable build or reproducible attack, destruction-count, collision, deployment, phase snapshot or tick-order trace.

sources.title: Crafting Station payload
sources.limitations: Pins L1 1,000 HP, 3x3 footprint, TH18 availability and source asset, but has no weapon or explicit standalone lifecycle.

support.note: The shared Core materializes the sourced L1 passive, targetable Defense-category building; it does not model a Crafted Defense, phase selection or an unsourced weapon.

implemented: shared snapshot/replay, Headless, Viewer selection and RL scenario paths
missing: official standalone targetability and destruction-count contract
phase state/snapshot selection and removal timing
Crafted Defense selection, modules and all temporary defense behavior
collision, deployment-boundary and same-tick ordering fidelity

partial_mechanics_contract.note: Secondary evidence supports the passive defense-target priority; the phase and all temporary crafted behavior remain unimplemented.

conclusion: Crafting Station L1 is now a source-backed passive destructible Core building with 1,000 HP and 3x3 geometry, exposed through Headless, Viewer and RL. Its phase lifecycle and every Crafted Defense remain explicitly out of scope or undocumented; no Station weapon or temporary-defense proxy is enabled.
